name: second-brain
description: Memory for leadership: capture what you observe about your team and recall it before 1:1s, PDIs and feedback sessions
long_description: A local-first memory for leaders. Claude reads your notes, 1:1 transcripts, feedback and screenshots, extracts who and what they are about, and stores them in a knowledge graph on your computer (~/.second-brain). Before a 1:1, a PDI or a feedback session, it brings back the history, pending tasks, feedbacks and recurring topics of that person. Nothing leaves your computer unless you turn on semantic search with an embedding gateway.

tools.name: ingest
tools.description: Store a memory about a person, with the people, topics, tasks and feedback extracted from it

tools.name: list_people
tools.description: List everyone already known, to reuse their exact names

tools.name: rename_person
tools.description: Rename a person everywhere they are referenced

tools.name: complete_task
tools.description: Mark a follow-up task as done

tools.name: delete_memory
tools.description: Delete a memory and what was derived from it, previewed before it deletes

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Get the context about a person for a 1:1, PDI, feedback or team review

tools.name: get_team_context
tools.description: Review a leader's team: pending tasks, last feedbacks, assessments and risk signals

tools.name: search_memories
tools.description: Search memories by subject, word or meaning

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Built-in profile: saipos, default, startup or personal. A config file at ~/.second-brain/config.yaml (from `second-brain init`) takes precedence.

embedding_url.title: Embedding gateway URL (optional)
embedding_url.description: LiteLLM gateway for semantic search, e.g. https://<gateway>/v1. Leave empty to search by keyword only, with nothing sent anywhere.

embedding_key.title: Embedding gateway key (optional)
embedding_key.description: API key for the embedding gateway
